title: 金鯱賞の後に・足元から伸びる影

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Whether by the will of the gods or her own efforts, Matikanefukukitaru claims victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After witnessing her behavior before the race, Silence Suzuka is worried about Matikanefukukitaru's preoccupation with luck.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Taking in Silence Suzuka's concerns, Matikanefukukitaru comes back to her senses.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Realizing her overdependence on luck, she freezes up, questioning whether any of her victories are really her own.
